records.text: Lantern Media is a week in with no project yet, worth a nudge at this point

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Lantern Media
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Lantern Media* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days post-signup with no project, no invite, no tickets, and no customer reply after the welcome email [email:eb3dd602] and held welcome call [calendar:7add9b7a]. Engagement exists (call attended) but zero product action in 6 days makes unaided activation within the remaining 8 days unlikely, though not implausible.

draft.subject: Getting Lantern Media's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week. Since then I wanted to check in on how the first steps are feeling on your end.

When you're ready, the natural starting point is one project with a few tasks inside it, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. There's also an in-app onboarding flow that walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
